Detachable keyboard
Turn the magnetic keyboard and touchpad on or off
Keyboard enabled
Keyboard and touchpad are active
Keyboard and touchpad ignore all input
Turning this off inhibits the input devices in the kernel. The keyboard stays physically attached and charging; it simply stops reporting keys, pointer movement and wake events.
On

Speaker enhancement (experimental)
Bass enhancement or Huawei Histen for the built-in speakers
Enable speaker enhancement
Sound from the built-in speakers is processed
Audio is passed through unchanged
Processing
Bass enhancement
Huawei Histen

Experimental. Only the built-in speakers are processed; headphones, Bluetooth and USB audio are never touched. Bass enhancement processes everything the speakers play, games included. Huawei Histen processes media (music, video) only, and games that use low-latency audio bypass it. Changes apply within about a second, except that Histen takes effect from the next playback. If the sound is distorted or cuts out, turn it off.
USB-C port
Problems with the USB-C port next to the power button
USB-C port stopped working
The USB-C port next to the power button failed after standby. USB data and standby will come back after a restart; until then the tablet will not go to sleep and keeps using battery.
USB cable connected the wrong way round
The tablet is powering the other device and no data connection was made. If this is a computer (USB debugging, file transfer), unplug the cable and plug it in again.
Boot loader
Notices from the boot entry (gk3boot), such as falling back to the previous system after a failed update
Rolled back to the previous version

The system installed by the last update failed to start, so the boot entry automatically went back to the previous version (now running slot %1$s). You can check for updates and try again; if this keeps happening, please report it.
A pending reset request was cancelled
A factory reset or recovery request that was still pending when the boot entry was installed has been cancelled and was not carried out. If you still want it, please start it again.
The boot entry recorded a problem
Before this start-up the boot entry recorded: %1$s. The system started normally; if this keeps happening, please report it.
This start-up bypassed the boot entry

The boot entry (gk3boot) is installed, but this start-up used the direct boot item instead: either the boot entry failed to start several times in a row and was skipped automatically, or the direct item was picked in the boot menu. A failed system update will not be rolled back automatically during this start-up. If this appears on every start-up, please report it.
Standby (sleep)
Let the tablet sleep when the screen is off
Allow standby
The tablet sleeps soon after the screen turns off
The tablet stays awake with the screen off and uses noticeably more battery

Turning this off applies right away; turning it on applies from the next time the screen turns off. No restart is needed and the setting survives restarts.\n\nWhile asleep, Wi-Fi is powered off, so new messages arrive only when the screen comes back on, and USB debugging over the cable pauses until the screen is on. Turn standby off if you need messages in real time, or while troubleshooting a tablet that does not wake up.
Touch feel
Game mode (no palm rejection) or everyday mode (palm rejection)
Game touch mode
Game: no palm rejection, so taps next to a thumb lying along the edge are not dropped
Everyday: palm rejection, a resting hand is ignored

Both modes follow your finger equally closely; they differ only in palm rejection. In game mode a palm or the base of the thumb resting on the screen may register as a touch. Everyday mode ignores a resting palm, which suits browsing, reading and handwriting, but while a thumb lies flat along the edge of the screen, taps around it may be ignored too.\n\nChanges apply right away, no restart needed, and survive restarts. A quick settings tile is also available: edit quick settings and add \"Game touch\".

Enter a version such as 6.6.30, using only letters, digits and . _ + -, at most 64 characters.
Real kernel version

Some apps only accept running on kernel 6.x or older. This setting only affects the kernel version number that non-system apps read; system components can still read the real version. Changes apply after a restart.
